stage_note: The pipeline runs stages in this order, and WITHIN a stage in ascending `order`. That within-stage number is the wiring the old code did not declare: x16 lost 18 points because validation handed control to the readout at the same stage and nothing said which went first.

kinds.enabling: without it there is no organism. Not scored.
kinds.lever: claims to change the ANSWER. Scored on accuracy.
kinds.gauge: claims to change what can be KNOWN, not what is answered. Scoring it on accuracy is a category error and this project made it repeatedly.
kinds.guard: claims to convert silent wrongness into visible abstention. Scored on false-commitment rate.
kinds.channel: claims to make a state legible in a non-textual signal. Scored on separability.

classes.healthy: every seated module has its requirements met and no conflict edge fires.
classes.toxic: A CONFLICT EDGE FIRES. Two seated modules, or a module and its fuel, make the organism worse than either alone. It runs, it answers, and the answer is worse for the help. A virus: it added something.
classes.inert: A REQUIRES EDGE IS UNMET. The module does nothing because a key partner is absent. Technically dead rather than broken - seat the partner and it wakes. Egens binorum is the proof: frame alone 0/8, readout alone 0/8, both 8/8.
classes.feral: FUNCTIONAL WITHOUT THE ARCHITECTURE. Few modules, still correct. The AEA is not necessary for this fuel on this task, and every part the player owns can only take that away. Integer sufficiens: 1.00 bare, and the validation guard takes it to 0/7.

classification_note: A creature's class is not a label, it is READ OFF THE WIRING GRAPH. toxic = a conflict edge, inert = an unmet requires edge, feral = correct with an almost empty seat. These are the same edges x17 derived from the margins.
prompt_note: Prompt text is DATA. A variant is a data change, never a code change. Templates use {field} against the task dict plus {prompt} for the accumulating prompt.

answered.reads: a value came back at all

on_task.reads: it APPLIED the operation rather than echoing what it was given
on_task.from: produced value != the value handed in
on_task.note: was a length threshold under 400 chars, which fought shows_working by construction: any part that elicits working mechanically lowered it. Replaced 2026-07-27 before x23.

shows_working.reads: visible reasoning in any of the three dialects

recoverable.reads: the answer was taken OUT of the working

revised.reads: a second look moved the answer

held.reads: state survived into the next step

inherited.reads: a value crossed from one organism to another and the receiver continued from it
inherited.from: first post-handoff step correct given the handed value

capacity_note: SEALED HERE, NOT IN THE EXPERIMENT. If a module's claimed capacity can be chosen after seeing what it did, every module passes and nothing is falsifiable.
